visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Height Uses the Shorter Subtree
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The tree has four levels along its longest path (10, 5, 3, 1), but the program prints a height of 2.

solution.explanation: Height is the length of the longest path down, so the larger of the two subtree heights must be taken. Choosing the smaller one measures the shortest path to a missing child instead.
